# fptcloud_database_proxy_restart (Resource)

Restarts a DB proxy and waits until it is running again. Creating the resource, or changing `triggers`, restarts the proxy; connections through it are dropped.

Resource dạng "action": tạo resource hoặc đổi `triggers` thì restart proxy và **đợi** về `running`. Proxy phải `running` hoặc `warning`
(portal không tự kiểm tra trạng thái nên provider kiểm tra). Đổi `proxy_id` hoặc `vpc_id` chỉ cập nhật state và báo cảnh báo; muốn restart lại
mà không đổi `triggers` thì dùng `terraform apply -replace=...`. Xoá resource không gọi API. Không có `ForceNew`.

## Schema

### Required

- `proxy_id` (String) The Id of the proxy, for example `fptcloud_database_proxy.db.id`. It must be running (or in warning) to restart.
- `vpc_id` (String) The Id of the VPC of the proxy.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) Timeouts for the long operations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary values; when one changes, the proxy restarts again.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The Id of the proxy.
- `restarted_at` (String) When the proxy was last restarted by Terraform (UTC, RFC 3339).

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) How long to wait for the operation, as a duration such as `45m` or `1h`. Default 45m.
- `update` (String) How long to wait for the operation, as a duration such as `45m` or `1h`. Default 45m.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Restart the proxy. Change `triggers` to restart it again.
resource "fptcloud_database_proxy_restart" "db" {
  proxy_id = fptcloud_database_proxy.db.id
  vpc_id   = var.vpc_id

  triggers = {
    run = "2026-11-05"
  }
}
```
